item.title: github: Bring business context with external custom properties
item.description:
GitHub now supports external custom properties so repository business context can be synced from a system of record such as a CMDB, internal developer portal, or other in-house system. This lets teams attach external metadata to repositories more seamlessly.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: npm publish-time malware scanning and dual-use metadata
item.description:
npm is adding automatic malware scanning when packages are published, along with a new metadata requirement for packages that may be used for both benign and malicious purposes. The changelog says this is part of ongoing supply-chain security work and explains what publishers should expect.

  • Source: GitHub
